description: Officials and employees will be encouraged to use ChatGPT, Claude and other AI-based applications to simplify academic and administrative work, analyse information and monitor educational schemes.
body_lead: Patna: The Bihar Education Department is set to promote the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in government schools and educational institutions across the state. As part of this initiative, the department has issued a letter to all District Education Officers (DEOs), directing them to encourage officials and employees to use AI technology in their academic and administrative work. The initiative aims to make educational and administrative activities simpler, more organised and effective.
